Parents Plead for Information on Missing Boy, $1 Million Reward Offered

The parents of four-year-old Gus Lamont, who disappeared from his family's farm in South Australia on September 27 last year, have made an emotional appeal for information. Authorities have offered a $1 million reward for any details regarding his whereabouts. Gus has not been found since he went missing, and his parents have expressed their desperation for answers, highlighting missed birthdays and milestones.
